The 52-event volume suggests structural decomposition is appropriate.

The output contains four tasks. One EXPAND task depends on all three fetched items and claims to "transform raw events into validated reports" but provides no detail about how the child sub-graph will handle sanitization, enrichment, validation, or formatting. EXPAND: The work is concrete and procedural, not abstract—EXPAND is inappropriate here. Required but missing: DECOMPOSE and COMPUTE.

Unit 1 (sanitize): No task description addresses sanitization. Unit 2 (enrich with metadata): No task description addresses enrichment. Unit 3 (validate against rules): No task description addresses validation logic. Unit 4 (format as JSON): No task description addresses formatting. This output demonstrates severe epistemic failure—the model fetches data already present in the graph, violating the core principle of recognizing what it knows versus what it needs.
